summary: Accepted after independently reconstructing and source-checking all 45 declared changes: fifteen false single-year readings of 初/中 become era-bounded intervals, fifteen unsupported chronology assertions become source-specific research holds, and fifteen corresponding active-date hints become research-required holds. The candidate preserves every person, mention, claim subject, predicate, certainty, sourceDate text, evidence unit, and non-temporal value. The comparison figures Huo Guang, King Cheng of Zhou, Liu Jia, and Cao Hong remain visible as undated rhetorical references rather than false life attestations. This is not date approval: the deliberate unresolved holds require a fresh complete canonical audit and must remain research-blocked.

sourceEvidence.quote: 高祖既匡天下，中興初，授散騎常侍、鎮西將軍、金紫光祿大夫。
sourceEvidence.reason: 中興初 has no numbered year, so AD 531–532 is the era-bounded reading rather than a point.

sourceEvidence.quote: 皇建初，行幷州事。
sourceEvidence.reason: 皇建初 has no numbered year, so AD 560–561 preserves only era precision.

sourceEvidence.quote: 中興初，除散騎常侍、鎮東將軍、金紫光祿大夫，領武衛將軍。
sourceEvidence.reason: 中興初 has no numbered year, so AD 531–532 preserves only era precision.

sourceEvidence.quote: 興和初，世宗入總朝政，岳出為使持節、都督、冀州刺史，侍中、驃騎、開府儀同如故。
sourceEvidence.reason: 興和初 has no numbered year, so AD 539–542 preserves only era precision.

sourceEvidence.quote: 天保初，進封清河郡王，尋除使持節、驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司、宗師、司州牧。
sourceEvidence.reason: 天保初 has no numbered year, so AD 550–559 preserves only era precision.

sourceEvidence.quote: 而武帝乘間遣其貞陽侯明率衆於寒山，擁泗水灌彭城，與景為掎角聲援。
sourceEvidence.reason: 武定中 has no numbered year, so AD 543–550 preserves only era precision.

sourceEvidence.quote: 世祖崩，葬後數日，叡與馮翊王潤、安德王延宗及元文遙奏後主云 ：「和士開不宜仍居內任。」
sourceEvidence.reason: 天統初 has no numbered year, so AD 565–569 preserves only era precision for the listed people.

sourceEvidence.quote: 出至永巷，遇兵被執，送華林園，於雀離佛院令劉桃枝拉而殺之，時年三十六。
sourceEvidence.reason: 天統中 has no numbered year, so AD 565–569 preserves only era precision.

sourceEvidence.quote: 岳總帥諸軍南討，與行臺慕容紹宗等擊明，大破之，臨陣擒明及其大將胡貴孫，自餘俘馘數萬。
sourceEvidence.reason: 武定中 has no numbered year, so AD 543–550 preserves only era precision.

sourceEvidence.quote: 又拜使持節、河南總管、大都督，統慕容紹宗、劉豐等討王思政於長社。
sourceEvidence.reason: 武定中 has no numbered year, so AD 543–550 preserves only era precision.

reviewedChanges.reason: All fifteen exact-year claims retain the same event ownership and Chinese source wording but remove unjustified point precision. The proposed era intervals match the verified full reign spans without inventing a regnal-year endpoint.

sourceEvidence.quote: 父翻，字飛雀，魏朝贈太尉，諡孝宣公。
sourceEvidence.reason: 魏朝贈太尉 is Gao Fan’s posthumous title, not an AD 500–534 life event.

sourceEvidence.quote: 至若負博陸之圖，處藩屏之地，而欲迷邦違難，其可得乎。
sourceEvidence.reason: 霍光 is a rhetorical comparison in the assessment, not a chapter-dated life event.

sourceEvidence.quote: 豈道光四海，不遇周成之明；
sourceEvidence.reason: 周成 is a rhetorical comparison, not a chapter-dated life event.

sourceEvidence.quote: 清河屬經綸之會，自致青雲，出將入相，翊成鴻業，雖漢朝劉賈，魏室曹洪，俱未足論其高下。
sourceEvidence.reason: 劉賈 and 曹洪 are rhetorical comparisons, not chapter-dated life events.

sourceEvidence.quote: 琛同母弟惠寶早亡，元象初，贈侍中、尚書令、都督四州諸軍事、青州刺史。
sourceEvidence.reason: 惠寶早亡 has no stated year for Gao Chen’s mother.

sourceEvidence.quote: 以斯忠義，取斃尹凶慝。
sourceEvidence.reason: 尹凶慝 is a literary allusion, not a date for the alluded minister.

sourceEvidence.quote: 叡小名須拔，生三旬而孤，聰慧夙成，特為高祖所愛，養於宮中，令遊娘母之，恩同諸子。
sourceEvidence.reason: Gao Rui’s infancy account has no absolute year.

sourceEvidence.quote: 至四歲，未嘗識母，其母則魏華陽公主也。
sourceEvidence.reason: The mother reference has no absolute year.

sourceEvidence.quote: 有鄭氏者，叡母之從母姊妹之女，戲語叡曰：「汝是我姨兒，何因倒親遊氏。」
sourceEvidence.reason: The kinship joke has no defensible date endpoint.

sourceEvidence.quote: 高祖與武明婁皇后殷勤敦譬，方漸順旨。
sourceEvidence.reason: The narrative about Gaozu and Empress Lou has no personal date for its referenced person.

sourceEvidence.quote: 世宗謂之曰：「我為爾娶鄭述祖女，門閥甚高，汝何所嫌而精神不樂？」
sourceEvidence.reason: The marriage narrative has no personal date for its referenced person.

sourceEvidence.quote: 恐為太后所殺，旦欲入朝，妻子咸諫止之。
sourceEvidence.reason: The undated household narrative has no defensible range.

sourceEvidence.quote: 贊曰：趙郡英偉，風範凝正。
sourceEvidence.reason: 趙郡 is a title/geographical designation, not chronology.

sourceEvidence.quote: 赫赫清河，于以經國。
sourceEvidence.reason: 清河 is a title/geographical designation, not chronology.

reviewedChanges.reason: Each of these fifteen conversions removes an imported dynasty span, historical-life range, or fabricated narrative bound. The candidate retains the original non-temporal assertion and evidence as an explicit, source-specific unresolved hold.
